project_type: React + TypeScript + Vite social media app with Capacitor Android shell (mobile-first)
build_system: Vite + bun, Capacitor for native Android, Gradle for APK
verification_instructions: 1. Run bunx tsc --noEmit (must pass with 0 errors). 2. Run bun run build (must succeed). 3. Run bun run test -- --run (no new failures). 4. Run cap sync android + Gradle assembleDebug for APK.
setup_instructions: bun install (already done). For Android: export JAVA_HOME=/root/.local/share/mise/installs/java/21.0.2 && export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET mode. bun for JS. Java 21 for Android builds. No emulator available for runtime testing.
contribution_requirements: Work on a feature branch. Push and create PR via gh api. Must pass tsc and build. Copy APKs to .lovable/ directory.
key_patterns: shadcn/ui components in src/components/ui/. Tailwind CSS with custom tokens in src/index.css. Framer Motion for animations. Lucide icons. cn() utility for classnames. Pages in src/pages/. Layout in src/components/layout/. Social components in src/components/social/.
directory_structure: src/pages/ = route pages, src/components/layout/ = shell/nav, src/components/social/ = feed/post/stories, src/components/ui/ = shadcn primitives, src/components/vibe/ = badges/avatars, android/ = Capacitor Android project
